description: Semantic contract defining the business meaning that downstream AI must preserve when consuming claim line items.

business_definition.grain: One row = one billed service line within a claim
business_definition.decision_role: This is the decision-grain dataset for the AI. Approve, deny, or escalate decisions are made at this level.
business_definition.uniqueness: claim_line_id is unique; (claim_id, line_number) must remain unique within a claim

units_of_measure.amount_semantics: All amounts are line totals, already reflecting units. billed_amount must NOT be multiplied by units.
units_of_measure.zero_vs_null: A numeric 0.00 is a valid value and is NOT equivalent to null. 0.00 means not-yet-adjudicated or not-yet-paid.

point_in_time_meaning.rule: service_date is the as-of date used to evaluate member eligibility, plan coverage, and applicable policy version.
point_in_time_meaning.policy_selection: Policies must be selected by matching service_date against effective_date and termination_date — not by plan name or text similarity.
point_in_time_meaning.temporal_join_requirement: All temporal joins must use service_date, not claim submission date or current date.

source_of_truth.claim_header_totals: claims_ledger.csv is canonical for claim-header totals
source_of_truth.note: The claim_line_items extract is derived, not authoritative.

freshness_expectation.batch_tracking: AI-ready layer should use the latest validated ingestion batch and retain source-file/batch provenance.

business_interpretation_to_preserve: One row = one service line; enrichment must not duplicate or change this grain
billed_amount is the line total (already includes units), not a per-unit rate
service_date is the point-in-time anchor for policy selection
denial_reason_code is populated only when the line is denied or adjusted
0.00 is a valid value and is not equivalent to null
Any correction to a source value must be explicit, traceable, and flagged — not silently applied
